name: Annulus Break
source:
A mysterious island.

A missing research crew.

Family drama.

And of course, interspecies telepathy.

An [b]annulus[/b] is the ring-like or collar-like structure sometimes found on the stipe of some species of mushrooms. The annulus represents the remaining part of the partial veil, after it has ruptured to expose the gills or other spore-producing surface.

[From [URL=https://krzyzis.itch.io/annulus-break-demo]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
一座神秘的岛屿。

失踪的研究人员。

家庭剧。

当然，还有种间心灵感应。

[b]环[/b]是有时在某些蘑菇的菌柄上发现的环状或领状结构。环面代表部分面纱破裂后暴露出鳃或其他产生孢子的表面后的剩余部分。

[来自 [URL=https://krzyzis.itch.io/annulus-break-demo]itch.io[/URL]]
